name: The Pit
desc:
**The Pit** was a limited-time combat area introduced during the Metallica x Deepwoken '72 Seasons' Listening Party. It functioned as a small arena where players could knock each other out of it to accumulate points and eventually earn the Headbang Emote and Metalhead Badge.

All damage taken whilst in The Pit was heavily reduced. On the other hand, knockback was greatly increased, and any attack would send players ragdolled flying.
additional_info: -   [The Ferryman](entity:the_ferryman) could sometimes appear around The Pit, seen as a spectator watching the Metallica band play.
